Structure violation: the module name `apply-discount.ts` is verb-first kebab-case, but the exported entry point must be named `run` per the spec.

Behavior violation — domain failures are values, never exceptions: the service throws for missing code, unknown parlor, etc. Domain failures must be returned as `{ ok: false, error }` values; `throw` is reserved for programmer error only.

Behavior violation — error messages for API consumers: errors are vague (`invalid input`, `error`) and do not name what was wrong or what would be accepted instead (e.g., which codes are valid, or listing valid parlors).

Documentation violation: the service has no doc comment stating its purpose in one sentence and enumerating its domain failure modes, so callers cannot handle every `error` without reading the body.
